title: Evaluate and adopt compatible same-model browser precision
description: Purpose: resolve measured q8 incompatibility without changing CLAP embedding space, ground model, inference location or numerical gates. Supervisor captures six real browser vectors against pinned Python and48 audio candidates and desktop warm timing, reruns tests/build. Missing mobile/listening remains explicit, never fabricated. Handoff: file inventory/red-green/evidence/blockers. No commit/push/close.
